page.layout: One page of text: a title at full width at the top, then a column header line, then a tree diagram with four rotated label columns on the left, numbered boxes 1–24 in the centre, and hexilogia labels with braces on the right. A summa line sits below the diagram at full width. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Typus, quo ostenditur, quomodo partitio philosophiæ conveniat cum hexilogia, itemq; cum objecto, circa quod occupatur, cum subjecto, quod informat, & fine, cujus gratiâ proponitur
main_text.l: Omne θεωρητὸν, quod cadit sub contemplationem.
Omne πρακτὸν, quod aptum natum est πράξεως.

page.notes: The rotated column labels on the left were read bottom to top, in the order they stand on the page. The Greek in the rotated labels (πρακτὸν, ποιητὸν, πέφυκε ποιεῖσθαι, ποιη-τικὸς, πράξεως) is small and blurred and should be checked against the scan. The hexilogia numbers "Prudentia 5." and "Artes 7." are printed as shown but are not clearly legible at this resolution. The diagram levels are a reading of the braces; the inner brace around 7–12 may be one level deeper than shown. The printed title is set in small capitals in the original; it is transcribed here in ordinary case.
